honors.title: Innovation in Development Finalist
honors.description: "The objective for Snagajob's Worker Engagement Squad is to manage and improve worker engagement with Snagajob's services. To do so, the Squad handles multiple different channels. Operations for one of the engagement channels - email - were completely handled via a managed third party service. As Snagajob grew, not only did the service provider experience performance and stability issues, but the cost for operating the service had dramatically increased as well. In early 2016, management realized that the current solution wasn't effective anymore and decided to assemble a TigerTeam of 3 Engineers (1 frontend engineer / 1 API developer/ 1 DB engineer). The team was tasked with architecting, designing, and implementing a new solution providing considerably better performance at dramatically reduced cost. The solution is an incredibly innovative system that combines a simple and very cost effective third party email delivery engine (SparkPost) with an in-house segmentation management service that is designed and build for horizontal scalability and performance.  The in-house management tier is running 100% cloud based and consists of a PHP frontend, .Net API, and Hadoop (Cloudera) and Postgres (AWS RDS) backend. The solution has been in production for 6 month, handles email campaign management for a user base of 75 million accounts and collects 2 billion behavioral (email send, open, click, apply) data points per year. Operational performance has improved from 1 minute to 15 secs (average) per campaign segmentation task and overall operational cost has decreased from $1 million / year to $250k / year (a 75% reduction).  Not only did the results exceed both project objectives but the team also delivered the project on time and with incredible quality. This is an impressive example of what a small team of talented individuals can achieve when given a clear objective and time to focus."

projects.title: GetOutCast.com
projects.description:
Capturing incredible photographs is part skill, but mostly good timing. GetOutCast is a web site and app that gives you good timing, letting you know when the conditions are best for many different types of photography. It answers questions like, should you sleep in tomorrow, or is it worth waking up for sunrise? Should you stay up late tonight and photograph the stars? When should you head to your favorite waterfall?

The only thing left is to practice your skills.
